title: Amend the board full-screen mode: measure the pane grant in a real pty and stop claiming a size the pane did not get (seq 223)
description: Operator test result routed via opum-doc seq 223 (opum-agent OPAG-1074): with a test copy of quest-cli dev 585f3ece loaded in the operator dev-mods session, the board full-screen mode does nothing on a real surface. Verbatim: pressing z toggles the label between Full screen and Normal size in the header, and the dashboard tool with full:true replies "Opened the Quest board, full screen.", but the pane never changes size. (ctrl+x tab doing nothing is NOT a defect: the band exists only while the pane waits undrawn, and the pane was placed.) Measure in a real pty, in both the main-screen and fullscreen layouts: what full asks for, what the surface grants, and whether a kept size exists for the pane id. Then make the pane honest wherever the grant is less than the ask: show the held-size hint and do not label the header or the tool line "Full screen". If the main-screen layout can never grant a full-size pane, report that to the orchestrator as a design issue with the measurement, rather than inventing a workaround. Fold onto the release branch for #486 under the seq 213 open window; report at the PR boundary with the measurements, then re-freeze the branch. lore-cli is running the same check on its own pane.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The task notes record, from a real-pty measurement in both the main-screen and fullscreen layouts: the size full asks for, the size the surface grants, and whether a kept size exists for the pane id.

Wherever the granted size is less than the asked size, the pane shows the held-size hint and no surface claims Full screen: the header control and the dashboard tool result line both read honestly, shown by a real-pty capture of the held case.
If the measurement shows the main-screen layout can never grant a full-size pane, the design issue is reported to the orchestrator with the measurement, not worked around.
The change is committed on the release branch chore/QCLI-433-bump-0-13-0 (PR #486) with the mod suite green, and the orchestrator receives the measurements at the PR boundary.

plan: 1. Measure the grant in a real pty, both layouts, with an instrumented probe copy: what full asks, what is granted, whether a kept size exists for the pane id.
2. From the measurement, decide the honest-labeling change: the held-size hint must fire and no surface may claim Full screen when the grant is less than the ask.
3. Implement in hooks/ (quest.ts geometry, register.tsx) with tests in tests/board.test.tsx; run the mod suite.
4. Re-measure the fixed copy in the real pty for the held case and capture the honest text.
5. Commit on chore/QCLI-433-bump-0-13-0, report the measurements to the orchestrator at the PR boundary, re-freeze #486.
6. If the main-screen layout can never grant a full-size pane, report that as a design issue with the measurement, not a workaround.
implementationNotes:
SEQ 223 MEASUREMENT, real pty (tmux, Claude Code 2.1.288), instrumented copy of the branch plugin under a probe plugin name, pane id kept quest-board. Each fact from the probe JSONL plus raw tmux screen captures.
- DOCKED layout (isFullscreen true, placement dock): the pane render viewport.columns is the TRANSCRIPT column, not the terminal. Measured terminal = viewport.columns + bodyColumns + 1 at three widths: 120+79+1=200, 160+79+1=240, 90+109+1=200.
- INLINE layout (main screen, NO_FLICKER=0; isFullscreen false, placement inline): viewport = {columns: 200, rows: 49} = the whole terminal.
- Docked, the pane bodyColumns did not move for ANY requested columns: asks 40, 64, 70, 120, 180, 199, 200, 220 all left the dock at body 79 across two terminal widths (one earlier session read 109, unexplained); the drawn border sat at the same column in every capture. The dock width is surface-decided (kept or clamped); the request did not move it in any measurement.
- Inline, rows asks are honored up to what the layout spares: at 49 rows, ask 20 granted 20; ask 43 granted 30; ask 49 granted 30.
- WHY THE OPERATOR SAW NOTHING, reproduced: the mod computes the full request as viewport.columns - 20; on a docked surface viewport.columns is the transcript column, so full asked about 70 - BELOW the dock width already on screen - and nothing could change. Because granted (109) exceeded asked (70), the held test (granted < asked - 4) was false: no hint, while the tool line still said Opened the Quest board, full screen. Normal->full->normal renders all read dock, bodyColumns 109/79, and the header label toggled while the drawn border never moved.

SEQ 223 DESIGN ISSUE, per the orchestrator ask 3 (report, do not work around). Main-screen (inline) full requests cannot yield the largest pane the surface allows: the surface clamps the inline pane to what the layout spares (measured at a 49-row terminal: ask 43 granted 30; ask 49 granted 30), so the full request asks a size the layout never has. And by size alone the pane cannot distinguish that LAYOUT clamp from a size the person kept - the design 4-cell slack rule reads every inline full as held, so the held hint would show on every inline full even when the surface granted everything it had. The hint text (drag the pane edge to resize) presumes the person own size is what binds; whether a drag can beat the layout spare is unmeasured. Docked, the request was ignored at every tested width; whether that is a kept person size or a clamp is likewise not separable from the pane side. Routing to opum-doc through the orchestrator with the measurements above.

SEQ 223 RE-MEASUREMENT OF THE FIX, same real-pty rig (tmux 200x49, docked layout, instrumented copy of the fixed tree, Claude Code 2.1.288). The session dock was kept at 80 (body 79, transcript column 120), so the whole terminal is 200.
- The full ask is now the whole terminal: dashboard with full:true opened at columns 180, rows 43 -- previously about 70, under the dock own width, which is why nothing moved.
- The grant stayed the surface own (79) and the pane drew the held-size hint: render events read placement dock, bodyColumns 79, isFull true, hint "Drag the pane edge to resize; z switches layouts"; the hint line is on screen under the controls.
- No surface claims Full screen while held: the controls read Normal size in full mode and Full size (kept) after toggling back, and a capture of the held session contains the string "Full screen" zero times.
- The tool line reports the record: with a draw already answered it read "Opened the Quest board, full size requested; the surface keeps its own size, so the board did not go full screen. Drag the pane edge to resize; z switches layouts."; with no draw yet it reads "Opened the Quest board, full size requested."
- Mod suite 43 pass / 0 fail: tests/board.test.tsx gained the seq 223 regression and its docked fixtures now model the measured form terminal = viewport.columns + bodyColumns + 1. The tsc arm still exits 1 on the four pre-existing board.test.tsx errors (QCLI-451), none in the changed regions.
- The dock-width anomaly stands unexplained: across five sessions the dock sat at 80 except one at 110, and no ask moved it. Whether a person kept size or a clamp, the pane now says the size is kept rather than claiming full screen. The inline design issue (ask 3) is recorded above.

DEC-154 FOLDED (seq 227), 2026-10-03. Read by ref: opum-doc DEC-154 and the corrected design at opum-doc main 0dcfe074, via the GitHub API. Folded into the branch as 03a3aafa on top of 3c487f4c: inline full asks rows - 11 (8 prompt + 3 transcript); the dock ask is viewport.columns - 24 (the 20-column margin withdrawn); a kept width is the persons choice and is said plainly in the pane naming the store count, never editing ~/.claude.json; the dashboard line reports the drawn size -- "full size" only within the frame slack, otherwise the drawn size and why, or "full requested" when no draw has answered. Suite 43 pass / 0 fail. VERIFIED SIDE FACT: pluginPanes.dockColumns = 80 in ~/.claude.json, read directly (there is also an "asked" list holding seat-probe and probe-pane). That is the kept width behind the 80 seen in four of five probe sessions. CONTRADICTION REPORTED, per the ruling escape hatch: the only measured session that did not read 80 read 109 and stays unexplained; and this repo measured viewport.columns as the transcript column on a docked render -- 120 + 79 + 1 = 200, 160 + 79 + 1 = 240, 90 + 109 + 1 = 200, three points at two terminal widths -- where DEC-154 rule 2 reads it as the terminal width. Under a kept width both readings lose every request alike, so the difference is moot on this machine; with no kept width the ruled form would ask the conversation width less 24, below the terminal by the farm... by the dock, and the panes re-ask-on-size-change could oscillate as the dock moves. Reported to the orchestrator rather than diverged from. Inline measured grants also sit under the ruled cap: ask 43 granted 30 body rows at a 49-row terminal (ask 49 granted 30), where max(rows/3, rows-11) = 38 -- likely the pane frame and controls between body and total. NOT YET RE-MEASURED IN A PTY with the DEC-154 wording: the successor re-runs /tmp/qcli-probe/run-fixed.sh against a restaged copy of this build (see the handoff note on QCLI-453).
